bootstrap.label: project foundation
bootstrap.statement: Live to eat. Save every place worth returning to.
bootstrap.title: The foundation is ready
bootstrap.body: The mobile app, share web, and domain boundaries are in place before product work begins.
bootstrap.footnote: Maps, Places, and sign-in remain unverified until they run with real keys and accounts.

map.title: My map
map.subtitle: A private atlas for every good meal
map.canvasHint: Pan and zoom to explore a location. Your current location is not requested.
map.configurationBody: Add restricted iOS and Android Maps keys to see the live map in this development build.
map.emptyBody: Saved places will appear here as your own private record. Nothing from someone else’s map is added automatically.
map.savedPlacesBody: A newly saved place appears on this device first. Live map pins and the synchronized list come next.
map.locationNote: Location is optional. Start with any country or city.
map.previewNotice: Preview mode is on. Sign-in, saved data, and Supabase calls are disabled on this device.

placeSearch.title: What are you saving?
placeSearch.description: Search by a place or area, confirm the result, then save it privately to your map.
placeSearch.globalScope: Searching worldwide. Country and region selection will be connected next.
placeSearch.searchError: We cannot find a place right now. Check the server setup or your connection, then try again.
placeSearch.emptyBody: You must review a result before saving a place.
placeSearch.previewResult: Preview example · not a live Google place
placeSearch.notePlaceholder: Leave a note only you can see
placeSearch.privateHint: Notes and tags stay private and never appear on a public map automatically.
placeSearch.collectionLoadError: We could not load your folders. You can still save without a folder.
placeSearch.collectionCreateError: We could not create that folder. Check its name and try again.
placeSearch.saveError: We could not save this place. Check the connection and try again.

folders.title: Organize folders
folders.description: Deleting a folder never deletes your saved places. It only removes their connection to this folder.
folders.emptyBody: Create one while saving a place.
folders.renameError: We could not rename that folder. Check its name and try again.
folders.deleteError: We could not delete that folder. Check the connection and try again.

savedPlaces.title: My taste record
savedPlaces.description: A place is your private record. Change its note, tags, or visit status whenever you need.
savedPlaces.emptyBody: Search from your map to make your first record.
savedPlaces.previewMarker: Changes stay on this preview device
savedPlaces.recommendedHint: You can recommend a place only after marking it visited.
savedPlaces.notePlaceholder: Leave a note only you can see
savedPlaces.updateError: We could not update this record. Check the connection and try again.
savedPlaces.confirmDelete: Delete it? Press again to confirm
savedPlaces.deleteError: We could not delete this place. Check the connection and try again.

takeoutImport.title: Saved-list file
takeoutImport.description: This is separate from Google sign-in. Choose a saved-list CSV or ZIP from Takeout and inspect it on this device before anything is imported.
takeoutImport.takeoutStepBody: You only need the Saved or Maps-related data you want to move.
takeoutImport.previewStep: 2. Inspect the list on your device
takeoutImport.previewStepBody: This does not save places or change your original Google list.
takeoutImport.privacyHint: The original file is not uploaded or saved to your map yet.
takeoutImport.emptyPreview: There are no readable place rows. You can check the file format or excluded items in the next step.
takeoutImport.nextBoundary: This is only a file preview. The next step will confirm each place candidate and region before any private save begins.
takeoutImport.reviewStartError: We could not start this import. Check your sign-in and connection, then try again.

errors.CSV_MALFORMED: This CSV has a broken quote or row, so it was not read.
errors.INVALID_COLLECTION_NAME: This list name is too long or invalid, so it was not read.
errors.CSV_TOO_LARGE: Each CSV must be 5 MB or smaller.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: A ZIP must be 25 MB or smaller.
errors.READ_FAILED: The file could not be read. Choose it again from Files or Downloads.
errors.TOO_MANY_FILES: There are too many files to inspect at once.
errors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: Import preview supports up to 1,000 rows.
errors.TOTAL_TOO_LARGE: The uncompressed archive is beyond the safety limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Choose one ZIP, or one or more saved-list CSV files.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_HEADER: No known Takeout saved-list header was found.
errors.ZIP_ENCRYPTED: Password-protected ZIP files are not opened by this app.
errors.ZIP_INVALID: This ZIP could not be checked safely, so it was not opened.
errors.ZIP_NESTED: This ZIP contains another archive, so it was not opened.
errors.ZIP_NO_SAVED_LIST: No saved-list CSV was found in this ZIP.
errors.ZIP_PATH_UNSAFE: This ZIP has an unsafe path, so it was not opened.
errors.ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_COMPRESSION: This ZIP compression is unsupported. Choose its CSV directly instead.

takeoutReview.title: Confirm a place
takeoutReview.noteKept: The source note stays only in your private record
takeoutReview.searchHint: Choose the matching result yourself. We never confirm it automatically.
takeoutReview.queryHint: Enter at least two characters, then search.
takeoutReview.searchError: We could not find candidates. Try a different name.
takeoutReview.regionHint: A list folder name never becomes a region automatically.
takeoutReview.noRegionsAvailable: There are no regions to choose right now. You can save without one.
takeoutReview.regionLoadError: We could not load regions. You can save without one.
takeoutReview.saveError: We could not save this place. Find and confirm a candidate again.
takeoutReview.skipError: We could not skip this place. Try again.
takeoutReview.resumeBoundary: Only the result is kept briefly. Choosing the same file again resumes after the places you handled.
takeoutReview.previewBoundary: Preview only shows a result on this device. It does not save or send anything to a server.
takeoutReview.completeBody: The original file was not kept. If you choose the same file later, completed places will not be saved twice.
takeoutReview.previewCompleteBody: Preview results exist only on this device screen. Nothing was saved to your map.
takeoutReview.confirmCancel: Stop it? Press again to confirm
takeoutReview.cancelError: We could not stop this import. Check the connection and try again.

auth.loadingBody: Keeping your saved places private while we restore your session.
auth.configurationBody: Add the development project URL and publishable key, then configure Google and Apple providers plus the app callback in Supabase. No secret belongs in this app.
auth.signInBody: Sign in to save your private places, then choose the profile you want other people to see.
auth.googleBoundaryTitle: Google login is not a Maps import
auth.googleBoundaryBody: Signing in with Google never reads your Google Maps saved lists. Takeout import is a separate, explicit choice.
auth.accountRecoveryBody: Matching emails are never merged automatically. If you used another provider before, sign in with it first and use account recovery or linking once it is verified.
auth.onboardingBody: Your Google or Apple name is not copied here. Start with the name and handle you want for LiveToEat.
auth.handleHint: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. This cannot be changed in this first version.
auth.consent: I confirm that I meet the age requirement and accept the Terms and Privacy Notice.
auth.legalNote: Development-only consent text. Published legal documents and their versions are required before release.
auth.blockedBody: This account cannot open a map right now. Use the support and recovery path configured for this product.
auth.connectionTitle: We could not restore your account
auth.connectionBody: Check the connection and try again. Your session details are not shown here.

errors.CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: Sign-in setup is incomplete for this development build.
errors.HANDLE_TAKEN: That handle is already in use. Try another one.
errors.INVALID_ONBOARDING_INPUT: Check your name, handle, and confirmation, then try again.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: That did not complete. Please try again.

shareInbox.title: A place link is ready.
shareInbox.body: It has not been saved to your map. You will confirm the place before saving it.
shareInbox.discardHint: Removes this shared link from the device inbox.
